parameters.name: DataInterval
parameters.description: The time granularity. Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value 300 is used.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. This parameter is required. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. This parameter is required. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
